aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the report context but misstates the changed factor and uses insufficient outcome evidence.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not the tested condition.
Baseline and test conditions are marked unclear despite Normal and Test VP rows.
Outcome cites header/blank row instead of comparison data rows.
Function results are aggregated across dates/models/molds without subgroup keys.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Test VP forming with new mold number 4 versus normal lot.
Use baseline Normal and changed conditions Test VP Mold KR, Mold GN, and new mold as row-level subgroups.
Preserve date, model R/L, mold type, line, and assembly type subgroup keys.
Rebuild function outcomes from rows 31,33,35,37,39,41,43 with header row 29.
Add tension outcomes from rows 48-51 with header row 46.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are not sufficient; cite content rows plus actual comparison/result rows, not only headers.
